description.paragraph1: Glass - a timeless and fascinating element that has become indispensable in interior design. It symbolizes design and clarity and embodies a unique lifestyle.
description.paragraph2: At KURTH Glas und Spiegel AG, craftsmanship merges with a deep understanding of aesthetics, creating a unique synthesis of form and function. A highly innovative infrastructure in Zuchwil sets the owner-managed company apart.

glassCutting.title: Glass cutting
glassCutting.description: Modern cutting technology transforms large glass sheets into accurately dimensioned components with efficient, repeatable results.
glassCutting.feature1: Computer-controlled cutting head with diamond or carbide wheel
glassCutting.feature2: Precise processing from ultra-thin glass to 24 mm thickness

edgeProcessing.kicker: Finish you can see and feel
edgeProcessing.title: Edge processing
edgeProcessing.description: Every edge is finished for safety, function and a refined appearance—from practical seaming to highly polished design edges.
edgeProcessing.feature2: C-grind, bullnose, mitre and bevel options
edgeProcessing.feature3: Safe, tactile finishes for demanding applications

waterjet.title: Waterjet cutting
waterjet.description: High-pressure waterjet technology enables clean cut-outs, complex contours and individual shapes across an exceptionally wide range of glass thicknesses.
waterjet.feature2: Complex contours, holes and precision cut-outs
waterjet.feature3: Suitable for doors, tables, showers and custom components

cnc.title: CNC glass processing
cnc.description: The modern five-axis processing centre delivers individually milled, drilled, grooved and engraved glass parts in virtually any form.
cnc.feature2: All edge processes in one precise workflow
cnc.feature3: Custom mirrors, tabletops, shelves and doors

ceramicPrint.title: Ceramic digital printing
ceramicPrint.description: Photorealistic motifs and custom designs are printed directly onto glass, then fired so the ceramic colour permanently fuses with the surface.

tempering.title: Glass tempering
tempering.description: Two modern tempering systems produce toughened safety glass in a broad range of dimensions while maintaining consistently high quality standards.
tempering.feature2: More than 30 years of ESG production experience
tempering.feature3: Custom cutting and processing before tempering

curvedGlass.title: Curved glass
curvedGlass.description: Controlled forming processes create elegant glass curves for architecture, furniture and individual design solutions with accurately defined geometry.
curvedGlass.feature3: Large curved formats up to 2400 × 2400 mm

painting.title: Glass painting
painting.description: Careful surface preparation and precise multi-layer application create smooth, durable colour finishes for interiors and furniture.
painting.feature2: Available in all requested RAL and NCS colours
painting.feature3: Ideal for kitchens, glass doors and furniture
